preconditions: Use the private synthetic Kind deployment with signed readiness, protected workload identities, the exact loaded Qwen model, and a separate Data store for each controlled error.

normal_steps.action: Verify the final post-lock source and deployed Data files.
normal_steps.expected: All locked checks pass and the Data image contains the hardened source.
normal_steps.actual: 39 locked commands passed and four running Data files matched.

normal_steps.action: Run the protected workload twice with the model loaded.
normal_steps.expected: Each cohort reaches ten active sessions, two occupied slots and eight pending tasks, then creates two human-review drafts.
normal_steps.actual: Both independent cohorts reached the declared peak. Each produced two drafts and freed both slots.

adverse_steps.action: Interrupt only the isolated connector after observing each declared peak.
adverse_steps.expected: Preserve both compute reservations as uncertain, create no draft and keep scoped manual delivery available.
adverse_steps.actual: Both rounds returned provider_stop_unverified from Runtime, preserved both reservations and delivered one human-authored message on retry.

adverse_steps.action: Withdraw the temporary release and remove the isolated environment.
adverse_steps.expected: Preserve the original model and saved Docker environments.
adverse_steps.actual: Restrictive epoch and scoped teardown verified.

checks.name: final-post-lock-source
checks.actual: 39 of 39 commands passed, including 1,835 backend tests and 234 frontend tests.

checks.name: repeated-deployed-warm-and-errors
checks.expected: Two deployed warm and two deployed error rounds at the declared load.
checks.actual: Four rounds passed. Earlier failed and incomplete attempts remain recorded.

checks.name: true-cold-start
checks.expected: Measure repeated exact model cold starts when this check applies.
checks.actual: The user waived this check for this private synthetic qualification. Zero samples were collected.

checks.name: qualification-platform-cleanup
checks.expected: Withdraw the temporary deployment and verify saved assets.
checks.actual: Exact leased platform removed and preservation verified.

residuals: Human usability, language, visual and screen-reader review remains deferred to issue follow-up.
The cold-start exception applies to this private synthetic qualification.
acceptance_scope: Automated qualification of the private synthetic IMP-10 protected deployment, including the recorded scope exception. Earlier protected actor, replay, outage, Help and Static evidence remains linked as historical qualification evidence.
rollback: Advance the temporary qualification registry to an inactive epoch and remove its isolated resources. Preserve saved Docker review environments and the native model.
